style: Naturalistic cinematic garage drama, shallow depth of field, grease-stained surfaces, warm tungsten mixed with cool daylight.
soundscape: Diegetic garage ambience: irregular engine ticking, metal tool clinks, faint distant street hum through the open bay door.

subjects.description: An older mechanic in a faded navy work shirt, with gray stubble and grease-stained hands.
A younger mechanic in a dark hoodie beneath a mechanic's apron, with close-cropped hair and oil-marked hands.
A four-cylinder engine on an open stand with a visibly frayed auxiliary belt and oil-darkened hoses.

claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
The garage is a narrow independent repair bay with oil-blotched concrete, a crowded pegboard wall, and a rolling tool cart.
The older mechanic wears a faded navy work shirt and has gray stubble; the younger wears a dark hoodie beneath a mechanic's apron.
Warm work lamps mix with cool daylight from an open bay door, leaving tight pools of light across the engine bay.
The engine has a frayed auxiliary belt, oily metal, and a loose connector visible under the work lamp.
The scene uses diegetic engine ticking, a wrench clink, and a faint street hum, with no music.
